description:
Connect a signal of one node to a method of another so the saved scene keeps it, verified from the saved .tscn. The receiver should define the method. Then test it with summer_play.
Guide: summer_docs_read {"id":"tool/connect-signal"}

emitter.description: Node that fires the signal, e.g. './Player/HitArea'

method.description: Method name in the receiver's script, e.g. '_on_hit_area_body_entered'

receiver.description: Node with the handler script, e.g. './Player'

name: summer_connect_signal
title: Connect a signal
